notes.title: 2018-12-29 Update
notes.content:
1: The UI interface is rearranged to replace the new UI image resource, completely removing the old UI interface that the player has feedback. 
2: Optimized the game process, canceled the original space station upgrade model change system, and used the new space station. 
3: Removed the more cumbersome mining system that the player generally fed back to the old version, replacing it with a new planetary activity. o(* ̄▽ ̄*)ブ
4: Overall optimization of all spacecraft accessory systems, re-integration of thousands of weapons and accessories from the old version, and the addition of an accessory rating system to adjust the numerical values of all parts. 
5: Cancel the personal warehouse and space station warehouse, and re-add the player's total warehouse. Cancel the warehouse limit. 
6: Remove the accessory volume system, capacitor system, and transition system in the old version. (..• ̆_ ̆•..)
7: Re-adjusted the configuration algorithm of the incoming enemy. 
8: Add a new technology R&D center to the space station and use money for technology research and development. 
9: The cancelled transition accessory system uses a new technology development for fixed calculations. 
10: Cancellation of the capacitor system is completely related to the specification of the spacecraft. 
11: Calculate the maintenance fee with a new algorithm, add the parameters of the spacecraft commander, and the maintenance fee will be linked to the number of commanders. 
12: Cancel the old version of the mobile time system, the new version will be a turn-based game on a monthly basis. 
13: New Order-Point system, using the point to operate the space station and all the sites every month. 
14: Delete the old version of the trade map and delete the old version of the battle map. The new version uses a galaxy system to add a dynamic 3D planet model and divide all planets into galaxies. 
15: Added 4 new planetary activities such as Planet Mining, Great Escape, Ore Thief, High Jump Games. 
16: Removed the waste parts factory system, added the ore lottery center, and Exchange Center two star buildings in the Star. 
17: Added radar scanning system, players can use the Order-Point to scan the space. 
18: Remove the old version of the novice boot video, using a new game opening mode, players can choose their own family, custom family name and successor name, add a new story background, add a new game ending. (●’◡’●)ノ
19: Fixed the issue of vertical painting commonly reflected by players in the old version, and re-adjusted the avatars of hundreds of NPCs. 
20: With a new handover task system that optimizes the process of accepting tasks, it is now possible to accept tasks directly from all NPCs. In addition, due to the deletion of some accessories, the cumbersome task of the ship-type task has been greatly optimized. ╰(●’◡’●)╮
21: The model of all 200 warships was adjusted, mapped, and related scenes were adjusted. 
22: The new space station internal interface layout.
23: Adjusted the trade parameters of all merchants, optimized trade information, and greatly improved the cumbersome trade.
24: Redesigned the NPC Goodness System, which will have a higher probability of selling high-grade accessories than a certain level.
25: Modify the properties of all the warships and adjust the naming. (named normalization, solves the troubles of "obsessive-compulsive" players (●`∀ ́●)╯)
26: Rewrite the battle panel and the spacecraft parameter panel to cancel the extra parameters. 
27: Temporarily screen out the event system, and will re-launch new events in the near future, adjusting the relevant parameters of hundreds of events. 
28: Adjusted the sound effects of some UI buttons. 
29: Integrated defensive spacecraft accessories. 
30: Deleted the original mall panel, added a new trading panel, and optimized mouse operation. 
31: Deleted the original main interface scene, using a dynamic new scene, new LOGO
32: Cancel the durability system and its corresponding repair system. I hope that I can alleviate the irritability of the players caused by repeated operations. ( ̄ε ̄*)
33: Added the update bulletin board you are looking at. We would like to express our sincere gratitude to the more than 100 enthusiastic players who have purchased the game in the past month. Your support has become the driving force for us to make this game. I hope you can know that doing our best to make this game well is our only goal. We will continue to introduce new content to make the game more interesting and valuable. We have been paying attention to the various suggestions and feedbacks from community players. We have discussed each of the suggestions and strive to implement them. We know that there is still a long way to go before the realization of the ultimate goal, but your company is the energy we are advancing. sincere thanks. ✿◡‿◡

Finally: There may still be a lot of improvements in the current version. If you have any comments or suggestions, please send your thoughts to our email address shuaikun123@gmail.com

This information comes from 4 unpaid game enthusiasts who are making games on the space station.
